{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A robust economy will be essential to dealing with the risk of climate change.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group will insist on reasonable policies that do not force Americans to sacrifice their way of life or trim their hopes and dreams for their children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This perspective serves the people of the United States and also the world's poorest peoples.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The world's poorest peoples would suffer terribly if climate change is severe.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The world's poorest peoples would suffer terribly if the world economy itself were to be crippled.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must not allow climate change to become severe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must not allow the world economy to be crippled.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican perspective on the environment is in keeping with a longstanding appreciation for nature and gratitude for the bounty the Almighty has bestowed upon the American people.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The conservation of natural resources is the fundamental problem, and unless that problem is solved, it will avail us little to solve all others, according to Theodore Roosevelt.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Americans of all backgrounds share a commitment to protecting the environment and the opportunities it offers.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The public should have access to public lands for recreational activities such as hunting, hiking, and fishing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
